description: Source code for interrupt handling specific to Intel ADSP CAVS in Zephyr OS, including functions to enable, disable, check, and connect IRQs with support for dynamic interrupts.

methods.name: z_soc_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ, handling both core and CAVS interrupt controller.

methods.name: z_soc_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific IRQ, handling both core and CAVS interrupt controller.

methods.name: z_soc_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled, considering both core and CAVS interrupt controller.

methods.name: z_soc_irq_connect_dynamic
methods.description: Connects a dynamic IRQ handler, supporting second-level interrupt configuration.
